name: Guangdong Museum
scope: The standing Guangdong Museum exterior in Zhujiang New Town, including the elevated carved-box shell, west entrance and recessed roof court.
era: The exterior of the Zhujiang New Town museum opened in 2010, based on the exact cleared 2012 aerial view.

originalReview.notes: The exact cleared original shows the southern and western cladding patterns, deep red returns, raised box, and recessed atrium roof with raised rectangular skylight.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the exactly matched Qualla CC0 exterior. Architecture records supplied building dimensions and materials.
